questions.title: Number Row Echo Drill
questions.description:
Read a positive integer N and store the values 1, 2, ..., N into an integer array. Print the row on a single line with the numbers space-separated.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
A single line containing N space-separated integers from 1 to N.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Number Triangle Echo
questions.description:
Read a positive integer N and print N rows. Row i (1-indexed) contains the integers 1 through i stored in an array and printed space-separated.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines. Line i contains i space-separated integers from 1 to i.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Star Right Triangle Drill
questions.description:
Read a positive integer N and print N rows. Row i (1-indexed) contains i star characters. Store the stars in a char array and print from the array.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines. Line i contains i stars.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Symbol Square Grid Drill
questions.description:
Read an integer N and a single character symbol. Build a single row of N copies of that symbol in a char array, then print N rows of that stored row.

Input Format:
A single line containing an integer N and a character separated by a space.

Output Format:
N lines, each containing N copies of the symbol.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100, symbol is a printable non-space character
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= N <= 100, symbol is a printable non-space character

questions.title: Full Star Pyramid Drill
questions.description:
Read a positive integer N and print a full centered star pyramid with N rows. Row i (1-indexed) has 2*i-1 stars, centered with N-i leading spaces. Build each row in a char array.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines, each containing the centered stars.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Floyd Triangle Drill
questions.description:
Read a positive integer N and print N rows of Floyd's triangle. The numbers run consecutively from 1, with row i containing i numbers. Store the current row values in an array before printing.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines of Floyd's triangle, numbers space-separated within each row.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Stadium Seat Countdown Triangle
questions.description:
A stadium seat row i (1-indexed) has seat labels i, i-1, ..., 1 because seat 1 is closest to the stage. Read the number of rows N and print the seat label triangle, building each row's labels in an array before printing.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines. Line i contains the seat labels from i down to 1, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Sports Field Star Row
questions.description:
A sports field banner decorates each row with alternating star and hash symbols. Row i (1-indexed) has i cells starting with '*' and alternating: '*', '#', '*', '#', ... Store the alternating symbols in an array of size N, then print row i using the first i cells.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines. Line i contains i alternating symbols starting with '*'.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Inverted Star Pyramid Stage
questions.description:
A stage backdrop has an inverted full star pyramid of N levels. Row i (1-indexed) has 2*(N-i+1)-1 stars centered with i-1 leading spaces. Build each row in a char array.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines of the inverted pyramid, each centered.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Multiplication Table Triangle
questions.description:
A classroom desk chart shows a multiplication triangle. Row i (1-indexed) contains i*1, i*2, ..., i*i, stored in an array and printed space-separated.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines. Line i contains i multiples of i space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Hollow Square Frame Builder
questions.description:
A garden fence is shaped as a hollow N x N square of stars: only the outer border is '*', the interior is a single space. Build each row in a char array (no memset / memcpy / strcpy allowed — fill cells with explicit loops).

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines, each N characters wide, forming a hollow square of stars.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Pascal Triangle Row Cache
questions.description:
A mathematics exhibit prints Pascal's triangle using a single 1D array cache. Start with pascal[0] = 1 and all others 0. For each row i (0-indexed) update in place: for j from i down to 1, pascal[j] += pascal[j-1]. Print row i after each update. Do not use memcpy or any factorial-based formula.

Input Format:
A single integer N (number of rows).

Output Format:
N lines of Pascal's triangle, each row's values space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 30

questions.title: Hollow Right Triangle Border
questions.description:
A decorative wall stencil shows a hollow right triangle of size N. Row i (1-indexed) has i cells; the border (first column, last column of the row, first row, and the diagonal j == i-1) is '*', the interior is a space. Build each row in a char array (no memset/memcpy).

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines forming the hollow right triangle.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Mirrored Number Ladder
questions.description:
A parking-lot floor numbering sign shows a mirrored number ladder. Row i (1-indexed) has 2*i-1 cells containing i, i-1, ..., 1, ..., i-1, i — i.e. descending from i to 1 then ascending back to i. Build the row in an integer array then print it (no memcpy/strcpy).

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines of mirrored numbers, space-separated within each row.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Star Hourglass Builder
questions.description:
A theater marquee shows a solid star hourglass 2*N-1 rows tall. Rows 0..N-1 form an inverted pyramid (decreasing stars), rows N..2N-2 mirror back up. Build each row in a char array (no memset).

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
2*N-1 lines of the hourglass.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Triangular Number Staircase
questions.description:
A staircase step chart shows cumulative triangular numbers. Build an array tri where tri[i-1] = 1 + 2 + ... + i. Row i of the staircase prints tri[0], tri[1], ..., tri[i-1] space-separated. Do not use memcpy/strcpy.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines. Line i contains i cumulative triangular numbers.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Hollow Diamond Border
questions.description:
A jewelry template prints a hollow diamond of stars with size N (the diamond has 2*N-1 rows, the middle row spans 2*N-1 columns wide). Only the leftmost and rightmost star of each row are printed; interior cells are spaces; trailing spaces on each line are removed. Build each row in a char array (no memset).

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
2*N-1 lines forming the hollow diamond.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Pascal Triangle Sierpinski Mask
questions.description:
A fractal art exhibit overlays Pascal's triangle with a Sierpinski mask. Compute each row of Pascal's triangle in a 1D array (in-place update, same approach as Pascal row cache). For each cell, if the value is odd print '*', otherwise print a space. The result is a left-aligned Sierpinski triangle of N rows. Do not use memcpy or factorial-based formulas.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines of '*' and ' ' characters (no separators between cells).

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 30

questions.title: Spiral Number Matrix
questions.description:
A logistics warehouse floor uses an N x N grid with shelf numbers arranged in a clockwise inward spiral starting from 1 at the top-left. Build the matrix in a 2D array using four boundary pointers (top, bottom, left, right), then print the matrix. Do not use memset.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
N lines, each with N space-separated integers forming the spiral.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 100

questions.title: Concentric Diamond Number Frame
questions.description:
A clock face plate has a concentric diamond number frame. Build a (2*N-1) by (2*N-1) char array where cell (i,j) inside the diamond (Manhattan distance from center <= N-1) is the digit '0' + (N - distance), and outside the diamond is a space. Print each row, stripping trailing spaces. Do not use memcpy/strcpy/memset.

Input Format:
A single integer N.

Output Format:
2*N-1 lines forming the concentric diamond of digits.

Constraints:
1 <= N <= 9
